title: What has changed
status: approved by the vertical domain expert, 23 Nov 2026

entries.change: Fingerprints stored for every raw data file; the PPP benchmark recorded for each edition; agreement rates of the cross-checks published.
Explanations rerun with the current code for the questions answered with figures.
Controlled vocabulary of measures, economies and input flags, approved by the vertical domain expert. The flag 'nowcast' replaces 'estimated' and 'backfilled'.
Catalogue of measures added to the knowledge graph, so typed questions can be matched to a measure.
Corpus of quoted passages settled for the demonstrator; every sentence checked word for word against its source.
Both WDI editions and Penn World Table 11.0 read and stored; adjusted net national income after its last published year filled and flagged.
WDI edition of 8 October 2026, used as the latest edition. Its purchasing power parities rest on ICP 2021.
Penn World Table 11.0: hours worked and persons in work, to 2023.
WDI March 2024 edition, used as the archive edition for revisions. Its purchasing power parities rest on ICP 2017.
